final: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(rental_total) AS store_average FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.rental_total) AS total_kept_rentals, AVG(rt.rental_total - sa.store_average) AS average_excess FROM rental_totals AS rt JOIN store_averages AS sa ON rt.store_id = sa.store_id WHERE rt.rental_total > sa.store_average GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id
